2381: Kazuma is a former member of the Kannagi household. He was banished from the family by his father after he was defeated by Ayano during the Successor Ceremony for the Enraiha, his family's sacred sword.
2382: Ayano is a skilled En-Jutsushi and the successor to the Kannagi family's head. She is arrogant and irrational, usually taking action by herself even while going against orders. Though she seems undisciplined, she is very proud of her heritage.
3005: Kazuma's younger brother. He looks up to his Ayano Nee-sama and practically idolises his Kazuma Nii-sama, stating that one day he hopes to be as strong as him so he can protect everyone.
4328: One of Ayano's best friends and classmates. She and Yukari know about the existence of jutsushi. Nanase is also a very athletic student, who is part of many of their school's athletic clubs, and is admired by many of the female students.
4329: One of Ayano's best friends and classmates. Yukari, along with Nanase, often teases Ayano about her apparent crush on Kazuma. She is well-connected to the information network of the student body and often knows what is happening around the school.
4369: Ayano's father and Genma's cousin. He is the current head of the Kannagi family. Jūgo worries about his headstrong daughter. Contrary to the Kannagi doctrine that is based solely on strength, Jūgo has been trying to stop discrimination against the Fūga Clan.
4370: Ren and Kazuma's strict father. Though he is responsible for banishing Kazuma from the Kannagi family, he only wanted his son to find his own path.
4371: A detective working for the Tokyo MPD's Special Investigation Unit, in charge of investigating crimes related to jutsu. She occasionally works together with Kazuma.
4483: A member of an American family of En-Jutsushis, specially skilled in creating and controlling spirit beasts to harness flames. She manipulates myriads of spirits into a single virtual persona to grasp tremendous power.
4484: The girl Kazuma loved but could not protect. She was used as a sacrifice to summon the demon Lapis, who now resides in her body. It was said that her last thoughts of Kazuma was that she wanted him dead.
16742: Ayumi Tsuwabuki is Ren Kannagi's first love,
24653: Misao is a girl from the Kannagi household. Although a kind person at heart, having saved Kazuma from bullying ten years ago, Misao blames Kazuma for her brother's death and attempts to kill him several times.
29459: A classmate of Ren Kannagi and Tatsuya Serizawa. She seems to have a crush with Ren and tries her best to get his attention, though she gets into a fight with Tatsuya over Ren, since he wants to be with Ren (bestfriends?).
29982: A young boy from the Stars of Sagacity, an organization related to Kazuma's past and Cui-Lin's death. He uses Misao's anger at Kazuma and promised to grant her wishes. In truth, he only uses her as a medium, in order to obtain enough yoki, or life energy, to kill Kazuma.
37418: Misao's older brother. He and another branch family member were instructed to bring in Kazuma for questioning when members of the Kannagi branch families started to be killed.
37419: Misao and Takeya's father, Masayuki appears to be a typical branch family head, seemingly devoid of any familial love for his children. After Misao uses her dark powers to go on a killing spree, Masayuki and several members of his family resolve to kill her themselves.
37420: Chosen as a vessel for the Fuga clan's god, a wind demon. After Kazuma returns to Japan, Ryuuya goes on a killing spree, murdering several members of the Kannagi branch families using wind magic, making it appear as though Kazuma was responsible.
37421: Ryuuya's father and head of the Fuga clan, a clan of wind magic users who had been forced to serve the Kannagi family as scouts of low-rank for 300 years.
38228: A mischievous fairy who played scared people at Ayano's school, causing everyone at the school to think that a ghost was haunting the place. Tiana later approaches Kazuma about a treasure that was stolen from the king of the fairies, and hires him to retrieve it.
38376: The first member of the Kannagi family to meet Kazuma upon his return to Japan. Hired for the same job as Kazuma, to rid a wealthy man's home of a ghost, Shingo was initially demeaning of Kazuma as he believed Kazuma was as weak as he used to be.
38377: One of Ren's best friends. Always butting heads with Kanon Suzuhara, Tatsuya is always trying to keep Ren to himself in order to help him pursue more manly things in life.
40342: The chairman of Armagest, a powerful organization of modern magic users.
40538: A rouge magic user with a cocky attitude (like most of them), Hellhound attacks with a flaming dog he that commands, hence his name.
40542: A rookie detective with the police, Daiki is overwhelmed by the realities of magic and sprites, especially when Kazuma uses him to draw out a rouge magic user.
41084: A rouge magic user whose real name is never mentioned, Miracle dresses like a stereotypical magic girl and uses a wand to launch energy stars at her opponents.
